From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@talentprime.com>

Subject: Comp & on-call stipend for SDE2 - initial proposal

Team — attaching the draft offer for Emily (SDE2, IC2). Two items I want signoff on before I ask HR to issue: base/bonus/equity mix and a proposed on-call stipend (candidate has production infra experience and asked about compensation for occasional pager rotations).

Quick summary of proposed package in the attached PDF:
- Base salary: $150,000
- Target annual bonus: 10% (market comp)
- RSU grant: $48,000 vesting over 4 years, 25% after 1 year (standard)
- One-time sign-on: $10,000 (split over first 12 months for budget)
- Proposed on-call stipend: $2,000/year (paid monthly pro-rata)

Constraints: we still have a partial hiring freeze in the infra org — finance flagged on-call stipends and sign-on amortization as needing manager + compensation committee approval.

Ask: Karthik & Marissa — can you confirm the comp mix above and advise whether the on-call stipend is OK under current budget? Laura, can you confirm headcount is clear for this req? Sanjay/Emily — holding off on sending formal offer until we confirm.

Attachments: SDE2_Offer_Draft.pdf (pdf), comp-authorization-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Director, Platform Eng
Redwood Inference

Agree with the base and bonus targets — $150k / 10% is within the band for IC2 in our region. A couple items to call out: 

- RSU: $48k over 4y looks fine; confirm if we want an accelerated first-year tranche (I prefer standard 25% at 12 months unless there's a critical hiring risk).
- Sign-on: $10k amortized over 12 months is fine from a cost-center perspective but finance will want the amortization schedule on the comp matrix.
- On-call stipend: I need Marissa's sign-off; if we treat it as a recurring compensation line (2k/yr), confirm it won't push the role out of band or create an exception we have to document.

Laura — do you have capacity to confirm headcount allocation for this req (team 3A) today?

-Karthik

Subject: Re: Comp & on-call stipend for SDE2 - initial proposal

Thanks for the clear rundown, Alex. I reviewed against our comp bands and the comp-authorization-matrix (attached) — here are my notes and recommendations: 

1) Base / Bonus / RSU
- Base $150,000: within band midpoint for SDE2 (San Francisco region). OK to approve.
- Target bonus 10%: standard target; payout subject to company performance. OK.
- RSU $48,000 over 4y: this results in a total target comp roughly at band midpoint; OK as-is. No accelerated vesting recommended unless we need to close urgently.

2) Sign-on and amortization
- One-time sign-on $10,000: recommend amortizing across 12 months for cost reporting. Finance will require a one-line in the hire form with the amortization schedule.

3) On-call stipend
- Recommendation: approve a recurring on-call stipend of $2,000/year but record it as a taxable stipend line (not part of base). Rationale: small fixed amount that acknowledges on-call duties without moving the role to a higher band.
- Requirement: the stipend needs documented approval from Eng Dir (Alex) + Comp (Marissa) + Finance (FinanceOps). Karthik, please confirm finance accept.

4) Headcount
- Laura: per headcount system, this is covered by team 3A's allocation through Q4; however, there's an org-level hiring cap that requires exec nod for any net-new FTE. If this is a backfill we are good; if net-new, please flag for exec approval.

If all agree, I'll mark comp authorized and Marissa/Finance will update the matrix. HR can issue the offer with the stipend line included and the sign-on amortization schedule.

Attachments: comp-authorization-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

-Marissa Cole
Head, Total Rewards
Redwood Inference

- Base: $150,000 — agreed
- Bonus: 10% target — agreed
- RSU: $48,000 over 4y, standard 25% 1yr cliff — agreed
